## The Scene: The Fiancee
The party is in a high-end boutique in the Skyglass District getting fitted for noble attire to blend in for an upcoming mission. Renna is nervously checking the windows, trying to stay out of sight, when the bell above the door rings.
In walks **Brightlord Juran**. He’s impeccably dressed, arrogant, and flanked by two armored House guards. He's here on his own business, but as his eyes scan the shop, they lock directly onto Renna.
### Phase 1: The Confrontation
Juran stops, a cruel, satisfied smile spreading across his face.
> **Juran:** *"Well, well. Look what the storm blew in. Renna Palir. My runaway bride, hiding in a tailor's shop like a common thief."*
> 
Renna freezes, her face draining of color. She instinctively steps back, her hand reaching out to pull **Iiko** slightly behind her—a protective, older-sister reflex that she does completely without thinking.
Juran steps forward, looking at her with cold, calculating eyes.
> **Juran:** *"Do you have any idea how much embarrassment you've caused me? Running away from our betrothal like a petulant child? Your family’s house is crumbling, Renna. You need my family's backing, and I need your father’s signatures. I didn't pay your bride-price just for you to vanish into the night."*
> 
### Phase 2: Shaming Her Grief
Renna trembles, but tries to hold her ground, keeping herself between Juran and Iiko.
> **Renna:** *"I'm not going back to you, Juran. I never wanted this marriage. After... after my little sister passed away, I realized how short life is. I joined the Truthkeepers because I want to actually *help* people. I want to find answers. I won't be a political pawn in your game."*
> 
Juran lets out a sharp, mocking laugh.
> **Juran:** *"Help people? Look at you. You couldn't even save your own sister, and now you're playing dress-up with mercenaries. You're a coward, Renna. You ran because you couldn't handle the reality of your grief, so you hid behind a scribe's reed."*
> 
### Phase 3: Fina’s Flashpoint
Juran reaches out to grab Renna’s arm to drag her out of the shop.
This hits every single one of **Fina’s** triggers. He is an arrogant noble enforcing an arranged marriage, treating a woman like a transaction, and mocking someone for choosing freedom over a political cage.
When Fina steps in—blocking Juran's path and forcing his hand away from Renna—Juran sneers at her.
> **Juran:** *"Out of my way, outlander. You have no idea who you're dealing with. This woman is legally bound to my House. I don't care about her tragic sob stories, and I don't care about your dynamic with her. She belongs in the Skyglass District, in my estate."*
> 
Fina now has the perfect opportunity to draw her line in the sand, drawing on her own history of escaping a political marriage to look this man in the eye.
### Phase 4: The Retreat
Seeing Fina stand firm, backed up by the rest of a heavily armed, highly dangerous adventuring party, Juran realizes a public brawl in the Skyglass District will ruin his reputation. He steps back, adjusting his cuffs, his eyes narrowing.
> **Juran:** *"Enjoy your little playground adventure, Renna. But Revolar is my city. You can't hide with these gutter-scum forever. Your father will hear of this, and by the Almighty, you *will* fulfill your contract."*
> 
He turns and sweeps out of the boutique with his guards.
Renna asks if Iiko is okay before she starts hyperventilating.
## Why This Set-Up Shines:
 * **The Fina Connection:** Fina isn't just defending a random NPC anymore; she is actively staring down the exact monster she ran away from in her own homeland. It instantly bonds Fina and Renna as kindred spirits.
The Iiko Dynamic: By having Renna instinctively protect Iiko when Juran steps up, the players see that Renna's motherly/older-sister instinct isn't just a quirk—it's how she copes with the sister she lost.
The Stakes: Renna is no longer a passive guide. She is a woman hiding from a powerful, vindictive local noble who now knows she is in the city. The party will naturally want to protect her from him.

# Description
A dedicated Ardent of Vamah who sought to preserve historical truth. Trained in the ancient art of Soulcasting, he was a close ally of [[Lavrik]] and a member of the [[Vorin Devotaries|Devotary of Sincerity]].

# Appearance
Vedelis wore the humble grey robes of the Ardentia, though his hands were often stained with the ink of a scholar and the dust of ancient ruins.

# Personality
Vedelis was considered a kind and gentle soul, driven by a deep-seated belief that knowledge is the foundation of civilization. He held a secret, burning passion for objective history, leading him to join the [[Veristitalians]].

# Background
While serving as an ardent, Vedelis discovered that agents of [[Highlord Paladar]] were systematically removing and destroying books from the [[Vamah Archivum]]. Viewing this as an act of cultural erasure, he concluded that the current Vamah leadership was antithetical to the search for truth. He joined the [[Knights of Dusk]] to protect history and support the cause of [[General Spade]].

He was killed while attempting to secure an ancient Soulcaster from a temple to prevent it from falling into corrupt hands. Immediately before the squad engaged in the temple, he was witnessed sending an urgent message via spanreed. During the combat, he wielded the recovered smokestone Soulcaster to transmute clothing, and even a stone pillar to smoke; the rapid expansion of matter as it transitioned to gas created powerful blasts of air that blasted attackers away.

# Goals
- Protect historical knowledge from censorship.
- Support the [[Knights of Dusk]] in their insurgency.

# Hooks
- The research Vedelis conducted regarding the missing books remains hidden and could expose the extent of Paladar's censorship.

# Connections
- [[Ardent Kaelis]]: His close friend and fellow member of the Devotary of Sincerity.
- [[Lavrik]]: His collaborator within the Knights of Dusk.

# Description
A tall, restless Nurian mercenary and culinary enthusiast who serves as a Truthkeeper Enforcer while secretly spying for the [[Knights of Dusk]].

# Appearance
Standing at 6'0" with olive skin, Dahmian has deep dark brown eyes and thick black hair. He possesses the lean, athletic build of a stunt fighter and carries himself with an ease that suggests he is always ready to move on.

# Personality
Dahmian is a wandering soul who views the world through a lens of flavor and freedom. He is a mercenary foodie who is charming but perpetually detached, driven by a deep-seated fear of being trapped. He avoids long-term commitments, viewing them as "golden handcuffs" that restrict his choices. He only joins causes that offer him a clear exit or a chance to sample local delicacies.

# Background
Dahmian’s childhood was defined by starvation, a trauma that manifested as an adult obsession with tasting every kind of food Roshar has to offer. He has spent his life alternating between performing stunt fighting in acting troupes and taking actual mercenary contracts. 

He arrived at the [[Truthkeeper Camp]] in a wagon alongside [[Karani]] and [[Fina]], joining the organization in a later wave of Nurian recruits. While stationed in [[Salimset]], he single-handedly captured a [[Possessed]] individual and brought them in for judgment. This display of efficiency quickly elevated him to the rank of Enforcer under [[Adjudicator Peton]]. Upon his transfer to [[Revolar]], he teamed up with [[Beric Quinn]].

He is currently acting as an informant for the [[Knights of Dusk]]. His motivation for spying is less about morality and more about ensuring he is not trapped by the rigid hierarchies of the [[Truthkeepers]].

# Goals
- Taste all varieties of food and wine across the princedoms during his travels.
- Avoid any situation or allegiance that makes him feel trapped or restricted.
- Maintain his cover within the [[Truthkeepers]] while securing an exit strategy via the rebellion.

# Hooks
- **Restless Ally:** During high-stakes events like [[The Darkstone Siege]], Dahmian may be the first to abandon the [[Knights of Dusk]] if he perceives the situation as a cage with no escape.
- **Weapon Taboo:** Though his preferred weapon is a rapier, he adheres to Alethi martial taboos by wielding a shortspear and knife in public.

# Connections
- [[Karani]]: A fellow Nurian who arrived at the camp in the same wagon.
- [[Fina]]: A fellow recruit who arrived at the camp in the same wagon.
- [[Beric Quinn]]: His partner in [[Revolar]] and fellow spy within the insurgent network.
- [[Adjudicator Peton]]: The officer who promoted him to Enforcer following his success in [[Salimset]].

# Description
A gruff, fiercely loyal darkeyed steward of [[House Sathir]] who carries the weight of a soldier's past and a protector's heart. He has traveled to [[Revolar]] to act as the eyes and ears of [[Highlady Marise Sathir]] and ensure her interests are protected during the rising conflict.

# Appearance
Early 50s with dark brown eyes and a weathered face that belies his gentle nature. He wears well-maintained steward's robes. A significant leg injury from his soldiering days gives him a permanent limp, a constant reminder of the battles that prevented him from joining [[Highlord Kethren Sathir]] at the Shattered Plains.

# Personality
Dalen presents a "rough and tumble" exterior, often speaking with the bluntness of a veteran. However, he is a "sweetie" inside, known as "Uncle Dalen" to the children of the estate and trusted by the villagers. He is a devout Vorin who frequently invokes the Heralds. He is driven by an unshakeable sense of duty and a desire to help those in need without expectation of reward.

# Background
A former soldier and close friend of Aljun Sathir (Kethren’s father), whom he looked up to before Aljun died in battle. Dalen swore to protect Kethren in his stead, but his mobility-limiting injuries forced him into a domestic role. He became the backbone of [[House Sathir]]'s administration. He has now come to [[Revolar]] as a representative of the Highlady, offering a rare source of genuine kindness in the city.

# Goals
- Represent [[Highlady Marise Sathir]]'s interests in [[Revolar]].
- Assist the party as a reliable ally without requiring explicit payment.
- Keep a watchful eye on the [[Knights of Dusk]] and the city leadership.

# Description
A man of seasoned military bearing, Brightlord Antisar Spadis—more commonly just called General Spade—carries himself with the quiet confidence of a leader who has seen the worst of war. He is currently the target of a high-level purge by the [[Truthkeepers]].

# Appearance
He typically wears practical, reinforced leather armor in Vamah brown and gray. He was once the commander of Revolar's military before being ousted by Regent [[Highlord Paladar]] in favor of [[General Odrin Lesh]].

# Personality
Disciplined, just, and deeply protective of those under his command. He is driven by a burning sense of betrayal at the hands of [[Highlord Paladar]] and a desire to see Vamah ruled with integrity. He is known for surgical precision in his strikes, targeting the estates of corrupt officials while stealing supplies to feed the rebellion.

# Background
Once a highly respected General in the Vamah military, Spade was ousted through a series of political maneuvers by the greedy Regent [[Highlord Paladar]]. During his exile, he bonded a spren, gaining the abilities of a Dustbringer (Releaser).

# Goals
- **Overthrow Paladar:** Purge the corruption from [[Revolar]] through targeted attacks
- **Help the People**: Protect civilians when possible and try to do the right thing
- **Protection:** Protect other surgebinders from the judgment of the [[Silent Oath]] and [[High Enforcer Aylen]]

# Events
- [[The Missing Supplies]]: Utilized Division to breach Warehouse 14 for supplies.
- [[The Darkstone Siege]]: Slain by [[High Enforcer Aylen]] while defending the insurgency base.

# Hooks
- Vengeance for [[Lavrik]]

# Connections
- [[Highlord Paladar]]: The man who ruined his career and his city.
- [[General Odrin Lesh]]: His successor and bitter rival.
- [[Lavrik]]: A childhood friend and key ally and strategist in the rebellion.
- [[High Enforcer Aylen]]: His executioner.

# Description
A man of imposing presence, he wears the ornate, heavy robes of a religious fanatic—deep violets and golds that signal his high station. He is a cold, clinical individual with a terrifyingly sharp intellect.

# Appearance
Veden features with red hair and pale skin, paired with cold, light grey eyes. He is rarely seen without his staff of office, which is capped with a suspiciously large and perfectly cut emerald.

# Personality
Malice is the embodiment of "the law as a weapon." He views people as assets or obstacles and has no qualms about using extreme violence to maintain order. He possesses a cosmic perspective, making him patient and exceptionally dangerous.

# Background
One of the four Grand Justicars of the [[Bloodmarks]], Temeret Malice has spent decades consolidating power in [[Bodenar]]. He discovered the existence of a Perpendicularity and the secrets of the Cognitive Realm, which he used to fuel the growth of the [[Bloodmarks]] as his personal shadow-army. He orchestrated the sabotage of the [[Ghostbloods]] gem deal, ordering the ambush that resulted in the death of [[N'tal]]'s family.

# Goals
- **Monopoly on Worldhopping:** Seek to be the sole gatekeeper of the Perpendicularity in the Horneater Peaks.
- **Nurian Dominance:** Control the supply and application of Nurian gems.
- **Elimination of the Ghostbloods:** Systematically dismantle their influence in [[Bodenar]].

# Secrets
Malice is currently the only leader in the [[Bloodmarks]] who knows about the Perpendicularity. He uses this "hidden path" to move high-value goods and assassins undetected.

# Connections
- [[Arbiter Jalis]]: One of his ruthless field agents.

# Description
A mysterious figure and highly skilled assassin operating on behalf of the [[Ghostbloods]]. He has been dispatched to eliminate [[Amaram]].

# Personality
Cold, professional, and single-minded. He operates with a level of precision that suggests high-level training or supernatural enhancement.

# Background
Helaran's past is shrouded in secrecy, but he has risen quickly within the [[Ghostbloods]] hierarchy as a specialized wetwork agent. He is the brother of [[Shallan Davar]], and though she is working for the same organization to aid him, he is currently missing and presumed dead following the border skirmishes.

# Goals
- **Assassination:** Successfully eliminate [[Amaram]] as ordered by the [[Ghostbloods]].
- **Anonymity:** Complete his mission without revealing his identity.

# Description
The High Enforcer of the Silent Oath and the ultimate authority on eliminating the threat of the [[Possessed]]. In reality, he is the Herald Nale (Nalan), the Patron Herald of the Skybreakers, a figure of fractured sanity driven by an absolute, inflexible adherence to the law to prevent another Desolation.

# Appearance
A man of intense, terrifying stillness with dark skin and a face that seems carved from obsidian, marked by a precise, crescent moon scar on his cheek. When he summons his shardblade, his eyes flash a brilliant, piercing gold.

# Personality
The embodiment of cold, inflexible law. He views the world through the lens of legal precedents and believes absolute order is the only way to save Roshar.

# Background
He oversees the most lethal aspects of the [[Truthkeepers]] mission. He is waiting in the wings to execute judgment on the Radiants leading the [[Knights of Dusk]] insurgency.

# Goals
- **Pass Judgment:** Execute [[General Spade]] and [[Khria]] for the crime of being "Possessed."
- **Cleansing:** Systematically execute the [[Possessed]] to prevent a repeat of the ancient Desolations.

# Connections
- [[High Witness Yeshan]]: The only person he truly answers to, still believing in his wisdom.
- [[Istrum]]: His subordinate and Skybreaker pupil.
- [[Morrow]]: Executed him for possession during a demonstration of Truthkeeper duty.

# Description
A man of regal and commanding authority who possesses a visionary yet patient nature. In reality, he is the Herald Ishar, suffering from fractured sanity and conducting dangerous experiments with Connection to "fix" the world according to his own warped perspective. He is the Patron Herald of the Bondsmiths.

# Appearance
Regal and commanding, he radiates a natural authority. He is noted for his piercing eyes that seem to look through those he speaks to.

# Personality
A visionary leader who is immensely patient but brooks no dissent. He lacks empathy, viewing and treating his subordinates purely as tools to be utilized for his grander designs.

# Background
Known to many as High Witness Yeshan, he is the Herald Ishar. His sanity is severely fractured, leading him to experiment with the fundamental forces of Connection. Currently, he has largely abandoned his direct oversight of the Truthkeepers to lead holy wars in Tukkar under the identity of Tezim the Great.

- **Agenda:** Utilize Worldhoppers to establish a specialized force for hunting the [[Possessed]], driven by a premonition of Odium’s ultimate victory.

# Description
A woman of intense focus and strict bearing who serves as the "brain" of House Sathir. She is a "correct" lighteyes who believes her duty is to protect those beneath her, often hiding her warmth behind a mask of high-noble duty.

# Appearance
She has pale green eyes and is in her mid-20s. She dresses elegantly in robes that show signs of careful repair—hand-sewn embroidery covering small tears, visible only to an expert. She often squints when thinking.

# Personality
Brusque, efficient, and deeply caring. She is exhausted by political pressure but refuses to break.

# Background
While her husband is away at the Shattered Plains, Marise manages the family estate and protects their people from the predatory politics of Citylord Nilar Yenev. She refuses to use slaves, relying instead on parshmen and paid darkeyes, which marks her as a target for traditionalist nobles.

# Goals
- **Protection:** Shield the children of her estate from conscription and the darkeyes from Yenev's sabotage.
- **Alliance:** Find reliable partners to help maintain House Sathir's standing and trade.

-

# Connections

# Description
Regent of Vamah, Paladar is a man of grand gestures and dramatic blinks who exploits the political vacuum left by nobles away at the Shattered Plains to expand his influence. He is the primary antagonist behind the instability in the region.

# Appearance
Tall and bald with striking, bright yellow eyes. He is in his late 40s and carries himself with the refined, arrogant grace of a high-ranking noble.

# Personality
Greedy, corrupt, and remarkably harsh. He hides a ruthless political mind behind grand gestures, focused entirely on the expansion of his influence and the Vamah Princedom.

# Background
He seized control of Vamah during the absence of other high-ranking nobles. He ousted [[General Spade]] in favor of his friend [[General Odrin Lesh]] and is currently engaged in a bitter feud with House Sathir. His family manor in the Skyglass District was recently targeted by arsonists in [[The Cinder Evacuation]].

# Goals
- **Territorial Expansion:** Move the Vamah borders north into Sadeas lands through sabotage and "protection."
- **Suppression:** Eradicate the [[Knights of Dusk]] using the [[Truthkeepers]] as his proxy.

# Hooks
- [[The Highlord's Greed]]

# Secrets
He uses the "Possessed" as a political tool, allowing the [[Truthkeepers]] to purge his enemies while he profits from the chaos.

# Connections
- [[General Odrin Lesh]]: His close friend and military enforcer.
- [[Chip]]: His third son, Archisal Paladar.

A manic Thaylen spren researcher masquerading as an Ardent. He is currently assisting with the steamship demonstration in [[Tomat]].

# Description
A Makabaki woman in her mid-20s and a second-ideal Skybreaker. She serves as a reporter and subordinate to [[High Enforcer Aylen]]. Despite her stern training, she is a figure of mercy who struggles with the absolute directives of the [[Silent Oath]].

# Appearance
She wears her black hair in a short, practical crop and carries herself with military discipline. Her strike green eyes often betray a flicker of doubt regarding the cold directives she follows.

# Personality
Law-abiding and disciplined, but possesses a compassionate heart. She is a legalist who searches for "loopholes of mercy," attempting to interpret the strict letter of the law in ways that preserve life when it does not conflict with the higher mission.

# Background
Assigned to monitor the squad and the insurgency in [[Revolar]]. During [[The Darkstone Siege]], she witnessed the slaughter of the [[Knights of Dusk]]. In a moment of internal conflict, she interpreted the law's lack of a specific death warrant for the party as a valid reason for inaction, effectively sparing them as they escaped.

# Goals
- **Spiritual Growth:** Swear the Third Ideal - Ultimately decides on [[High Enforcer Aylen]] as her guiding law.
- **Mercy:** Protect those who are not truly a threat, despite the law's demands.
- **Tutelage:** Guide [[Ojog]] as he shows immense potential for the Skybreaker path.

# Description
An Alethi princess and world-renowned scholar, widely known as a heretic for her rejection of Vorinism. She is secretly an Elsecaller of the Knights Radiant.

# Personality
Logical, cold, and intensely focused on her research. She brooks no fools but values those who demonstrate intellectual honesty.

# Background
The eldest daughter of King Gavilar Kholin, she has spent years researching the return of the Voidbringers. She has recently taken on a ward, [[Shallan Davar]], while staying in [[Kharbranth]] to utilize the Palanaeum.

# Goals
- Uncover the truth behind the ancient Desolations and the nature of the Voidbringers.
- Prepare for the return of the Knights Radiant.

A young teenage boy secretly working for the [[Knights of Dusk]] and the son of [[General Spade]] who has recently begun hearing the whispers of a spren. He is an undercover agent working in the Shield Ring.

Barely into his teenage years, with messy black hair and light eyes that constantly dart toward unseen shadows.

# Personality
Usually happy and likes helping others. He is deeply traumatized by his capture by the [[Bloodmarks]]. Brave and willing to take risks.

# Background
Recruited by the [[Knights of Dusk]] after he was discovered whispering to himself by the [[Bloodmarks]], knowing there's a reward for his capture as a [[Possessed]]. He was captured by [[Arbiter Jalis]] during a transfer operation and held for interrogation regarding the rebel hideouts. He is a budding Windrunner, following in the footsteps of his future savior [[Beric Quinn]].

- Impress his father.
- Understand the voices in his head.

An Ardent of average looks, typically wearing the humble grey robes of his order. He presents himself as a devoted scholar, but he is a high-level infiltrator for the [[Ghostbloods]].

Charming and intelligent. In this version of events, he is no longer a loyal puppet of his organization; he has become a true believer in [[Jasnah Kholin]]'s research and is prepared to betray the Ghostbloods to ensure her survival.

# Background
Assigned to "befriend" [[Jasnah Kholin]] in [[Kharbranth]] to monitor her research into the Voidbringers. While the [[Ghostbloods]] intend for him to facilitate her assassination, Kabsal has found himself sympathizing with her cause.

# Description
An outsider to Roshar who feels deeply out of place. She is shy, scared, and a habitual people-pleaser who struggles with the reality of her new world.

# Appearance
Dark brown eyes and a short, stocky Alethi-like build. She has an unrefined appearance, characterized by heavy, clumsy steps and a nervous demeanor. She wears simple darkeyed clothing, often stained with ink.

# Personality
She is easily frightened and makes frequent mistakes due to her nerves, leading her to avoid danger whenever possible. She is a worldhopper who feels unprotected and vulnerable.

# Background
Brought to Roshar by the [[Truthkeepers]], she found herself isolated and terrified. She arrived at the [[Truthkeeper Camp]] in a wagon alongside [[Dahmian]] and [[Fina]]. Seeking security, she was approached by the [[Ghostbloods]], who offered her protection in exchange for her assistance as an informant and spanreed operator. She played a key role in liberating [[Sila]] from hard labor.

# Goals
- **Safety:** Find a sanctuary where she is not in constant danger or subject to bullying.
- **Ghostblood Support:** Maintain her arrangement with the [[Ghostbloods]] in the hopes that they will guarantee her safety.

- She is a worldhopper from Nuria (Mythos) who is actively reporting camp information to the [[Ghostbloods]] via spanreed.

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#darkeyed","#alethi","#rebel","#knights_of_dusk"],"last_updated":"2024-05-26T10:00:00","faction":"[[Knights of Dusk]]","location":"[[Stackhouses]]","created":"2026/05/19 16:23:35","modified":"2026/05/19 16:23:35","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Kaz.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:


# Description
A gruff, no-nonsense darkeyed leader of a local [[Knights of Dusk]] cell in the [[Stackhouses]]. He manages safehouse logistics and urban survival for the insurgency.

# Appearance
Kaz is a burly man in his late 40s with calloused, stone-stained hands. He has a thick, peppered beard and a face lined by years of hard labor. He typically wears a worn stone-cutter's apron over practical Alethi darkeyed clothing.

# Personality
Kaz is blunt and inherently suspicious of outsiders. He has little patience for the "noble ideals" of the Radiants, viewing the rebellion primarily as a means to protect his neighbors from starvation and debt. Despite his rough exterior, he is fiercely protective of those in the [[Stackhouses]].

# Background
Before the rise of [[Highlord Paladar]], Kaz was a respected foreman in the [[Revolar]] stone-cutting guilds. When the administration began seizing guild assets and turning a blind eye to [[Bloodmarks]] extortion, Kaz lost his livelihood after protesting the new taxes. He utilized his knowledge of [[Revolar]]'s architecture to help [[General Spade]] establish the first urban safehouses. He now oversees the "laundry signals" network in the [[Scarstone Quarter]].

# Goals
- Maintain the security of the safehouses in the [[Stackhouses]].
- Ensure the families rescued from the [[Bloodmarks]] remain hidden.
- Provide logistical support for [[Knights of Dusk]] strikes in the [[Slipmarket]].

# Hooks
- **Architecture Secrets:** Kaz knows of a forgotten sewer tunnel that connects the [[Stackhouses]] directly to the [[Shieldring]] barracks.
- **The Foreman's Debt:** Kaz still has connections in the labor guilds who are looking for a reason to strike against the [[Vamah Princedom]].

# Connections
- [[General Spade]]: His commanding officer whom he respects but occasionally argues with regarding tactics.
- [[Lila]]: A fellow resident and vital informant in his cell.
- [[Khria]]: Often coordinates with her for extraction routes.
- [[Beric Quinn]]: Fought alongside him during the rescue of [[Jory Spadis]].

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#darkeyed","#purelaker","#truthwatcher","#rebel"],"last_updated":"2024-05-29T10:00:00","faction":"[[Knights of Dusk]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/19 19:02:27","modified":"2026/05/21 10:31:53","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Khria.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A native of the Purelake and a founding member of the rebellion. She is a decisive lieutenant dedicated to restoring the Knights Radiant and freeing the people from oppression.

# Appearance
Lean and lithe with sun-tanned skin typical of a Purelaker. She wears practical, muted clothing suited for travel. Utilizing her Truthwatcher abilities, she frequently employs illusions to disguise herself as a short Alethi darkeyed woman to move through the shadows of [[Revolar]]. However, she still stands out because of her swaggering gait (as if wading through water) and foreign accent, which she claims is from the countryside. Looks like [[Mallow]] but slightly shorter (lack of nutrition, giving preference to her).

# Personality
Possessing a preternatural calm and a sharp logistical mind, always calculating the best path forward during high-stakes situations. While deeply loyal and decisive, she carries a quiet bitterness regarding the circumstances of her capture.

# Background
Her life changed after spotting a Mistspren in the shallow waters of the Purelake. After her sister mentioned the sighting to townsfolk, Khria was reported to the [[Truthkeepers]] and seized for execution. She was rescued by the [[Knights of Dusk]] during a caravan raid and has since become a key leader in the resistance. She had commissioned a map at [[The Shining Quill]] for an extraction route to [[Hearthstone]].

# Goals
- **Liberation:** Free the people of Vamah from systemic oppression.
- **Restoration:** Bring back the Knights Radiant to Roshar.
- **Reconciliation:** Safely reunite with or protect her sister, [[Mallow]], despite the "betrayal" that led to her capture.

# Events
- [[The Missing Supplies]]: Infiltrated Warehouse 14 disguised as [[General Odrin Lesh]].

# Hooks
- **Cartography Trail:** Her commission at [[The Shining Quill]] provides a lead for those tracking the [[Knights of Dusk]].

# Connections
- [[General Spade]]: Her commander, savior, and fellow rebellion leader.
- **[[Mallow]]**: Her sister from the Purelake.

# Description
A Nurian refugee turned rising Ghostblood operative who aspires to be a legendary criminal mastermind. He specializes in poisons, hidden blades, and complex social manipulation.

# Appearance
Short and wiry with an intense, darting gaze. Koloko has nimble, calloused fingers and often smells faintly of acrid chemicals and rare spices. He wears practical but well-tailored darkeyed clothing that hides numerous pockets for vials and knives.

# Personality
Deeply ambitious and deceptively polite. Koloko views every interaction as a chess match and values leverage above all else. While he maintains a "learned" and scholarly facade to mask his intentions, he is cold and efficient when performing the wetwork required to climb the syndicate ranks.

# Background
Koloko was a career criminal in the Nurian underworld before arriving on Roshar with the other refugees. He initially hired [[Doug (Guddy)]] as his muscle for the crossing, unaware of the man's secret history as a double agent. 

Upon arriving at the [[Truthkeeper Camp]], Koloko was eventually pulled aside and interrogated by the [[Ghostbloods]], who initially suspected him of being a [[Bloodmarks]] infiltrator. Recognizing their power, Koloko eagerly pledged his loyalty, proving his worth by feeding the syndicate intelligence on [[Truthkeepers]] troop movements and performing a series of sanctioned assassinations. He has since transitioned to [[Revolar]], where he has established [[The Prismatic Palette]] in the [[Stoneweave]] district.

# Goals
- Establish a high-end front business in the [[Stoneweave]] district to facilitate [[Ghostbloods]] logistics (Completed).
- Amass a loyal crew of "disposable" but effective henchmen.
- Master the chemistry of Rosharan poisons, specifically refining the use of [[Cremwidow Poison]].

# Hooks
- **Mastermind's Gambit:** Koloko may approach the party to help him eliminate a [[Bloodmarks]] rival, framing it as a "legal" Truthkeeper investigation.
- **The Poisoner's Request:** He is looking for a rare specimen of a plant mentioned in the [[Flora and Fauna]] records to create a new paralytic.

# Connections
- [[Undertaker]]: His direct superior within the Ghostbloods whom he seeks to impress.
- [[Sila]]: His hand-picked second-in-command. Koloko values Sila's hidden cunning over his raw strength.
- [[Doug (Guddy)]]: His former hired muscle.
- [[N'tal]]: A fellow Nurian whom he observes with interest, seeing him as a potential (if difficult) asset.
- [[Kuma]]: Intrigued by Kuma's ability to create custom tools for his "trade."

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#darkeyed","#alethi","#revolar","#informant"],"last_updated":"2024-05-19T10:00:00","faction":"[[Knights of Dusk]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/16 12:29:40","modified":"2026/05/16 23:33:20","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Lila.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:


# Description
A quiet, observant darkeyed laundry-worker in the [[Slipmarket]] who serves as a vital informant for the [[Knights of Dusk]].

# Appearance
Lila has the rough, red hands of someone who spends all day over steaming tubs of soap and water. She has short, dark hair usually kept back with a simple kerchief and a nervous habit of smoothing her apron when she speaks.

# Personality
Initially timid and soft-spoken, Lila possesses a core of steely resolve. She is deeply loyal to the [[Knights of Dusk]] and views her small acts of espionage as her way of fighting back against the regime that nearly destroyed her.

# Background
Lila was a modest seamstress in the [[Fieldwards]] until a corrupt Vamah tax collector falsely accused her of under-reporting income to seize her shop. She was being transported to the [[Stackhouse Slavers]] when a [[Knights of Dusk]] strike team, led by a disguised [[Khria]], intercepted the caravan. They freed the captives and provided Lila with a new identity and a job in the [[Slipmarket]] laundry service used by the city guard.

# Goals
- Provide accurate intelligence on military movements to [[General Spade]] by listening to guards in the [[Slipmarket]].
- Keep her cousin, a scribe in [[The Vamah Archivum]], safe from suspicion.
- Protect her community in the [[Stackhouses]] from [[Bloodmarks]] debt collectors.

# Hooks
- **Laundry Secrets:** Lila has found a blood-stained note in a [[Truthkeepers]] uniform that mentions a planned raid on a "red laundry" house.
- **The Archivum Link:** She can introduce the party to her cousin, who has access to the restricted maps within [[The Vamah Archivum]].
- **Hidden Shelter:** If the party is pursued, she knows a hidden crawlspace behind the industrial wash-vats in the [[Slipmarket]].

# Secrets
- Lila is currently hiding a wounded rebel messenger in her small room in the [[Stackhouses]].
- She has been stealing small, dun spheres from the pockets of drunk guards to fund the rebellion's medical supplies.

# Connections
- [[Khria]]: The leader she reports to and views as a guardian.

A skilled surgeon in Hearthstone, formerly the town's leader, now living under the shadow of the Roshones following the death of his sons Tien and Kaladin.

# Personality
Stern, protective, and deeply principled. He remains wary of outsiders but values the medical profession above all else.

# Goals
- Provide medical care to the people of Hearthstone despite his limited resources.
- Protect his remaining family, including his pregnant wife, Hesina, and unborn child, Oroden.

# Connections
- [[Toralin Roshone]]: Current town leadership with whom he shares a tense history.

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"completed","tags":["#npc","#darkeyed","#alethi","#merchant","#possessed"],"last_updated":"2026-05-16T15:00:00","faction":null,"location":null,"created":"2026/05/16 11:35:10","modified":"2026/05/17 20:59:05","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Morrow.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A former merchant from [[Revolar]] who was haunted by supernatural phenomena. He was identified by the [[Truthkeepers]] as [[Possessed]] and was subsequently executed by [[High Enforcer Aylen]].

# Appearance
Morrow is a man who looks older than his years, with a tangled beard and eyes that dart frantically as if watching something invisible in the air. He wears the travel-stained clothes of a merchant, though they are now little more than rags.

# Personality
Confused and terrified, he often speaks in half-finished sentences or mutters to the "shadows" following him. He is inherently kind, often trying to share his meager scraps of food with others, even while in a state of distress. He is driven by a desire to do good to atone for a shadowy past.

# Background
Once a merchant who found himself embroiled in dark dealings, Morrow turned his life around to become an honest man. However, his "snapping" occurred recently, and he began to see strange, geometric figures ([[Cryptics]]) that seem to whisper truths about his past. He was captured in Salimset by the [[Truthkeepers]].

# Goals
- **Atonement:** To perform enough good in the world to outweigh the secrets he carries—secrets the [[Cryptics]] find fascinating.

# Hooks
- **Hidden Past:** The nature of the "dark dealings" he was involved in remains a mystery that haunted him until his end.

# Connections
- [[High Enforcer Aylen]]: Captured Morrow in Salimset and executed him for "possession."
- **Rhilon**: A local shopkeep in [[Revolar]] who remembers him as a kind merchant who once exported grain.

NOTE TITLE: [[Ojog]]

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#nurian","#truthkeeper","#enforcer","#assassin"],"last_updated":"2024-05-29T11:00:00","faction":"[[Truthkeepers]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/19 21:40:04","modified":"2026/05/22 00:00:29","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Ojog.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A towering and lethal Truthkeeper Enforcer who arrived on Roshar alongside the other Nurians. While originally trained in the arts of healing, he has repurposed his anatomical knowledge to become a clinical and efficient executioner.

# Appearance
Ojog stands an impressive 6'4" with light blue eyes that allow him to pass easily as an Alethi lighteyes of significant standing. He typically wears the reinforced dark grey robes of a Truthkeeper Enforcer, carrying a shortspear on his back.

# Personality
Quiet, disciplined, and burdened by immense guilt. He has fully embraced the cold logic of the [[Truthkeepers]], finding purpose in the rigid enforcement of the law. His sense of betrayal by his former companions drives his clinical focus on duty.

# Background
Separated from the main squad early in their service, Ojog became a favorite of [[Adjudicator Peton]]. After the party's defection during [[Allegiance at the Abandoned Docks]], he took the betrayal personally, viewing it as a repeat of the misplaced mercy that destroyed his village in Nuria.

# Goals
- **Atonement Through Duty:** Serve the [[Truthkeepers]] with absolute efficiency to make up for his past failure.
- **Suppression of Mercy:** Avoid the practice of medicine to prevent accidental aid to the "unworthy."
- **Enforce the Silent Oath:** Act as the primary watchdog for internal dissent within the organization.

# Events
- [[Allegiance at the Abandoned Docks]]: Confronted the party during their defection; ordered their execution.
- [[The Darkstone Siege]]: Led the breach of the [[Knights of Dusk]] base.

# Connections
- [[Istrum]] — His mentor and fellow Makabaki Skybreaker.
- [[N'tal]] — A fellow Nurian survivor and current ideological enemy.
- [[Kuma]] — A fellow Nurian survivor and current ideological enemy.
- [[Adjudicator Peton]] — His direct superior.

NOTE TITLE: [[Renna Palir]]

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#lighteyed","#alethi"],"last_updated":"2024-05-29T11:00:00","faction":"[[Knights of Dusk]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/19 21:40:04","modified":"2026/05/21 10:31:58","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Renna Palir.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
An elegant Alethi lighteyes who is significantly more sympathetic than her peers in the [[Truthkeepers]]. She is driven by a protective nature and a deep, underlying sorrow.

# Appearance
She possesses bright green eyes and classic, elegant Alethi features.

# Personality
Renna is characterized by her kindness, trusting nature, and protective instincts. While she carries a heavy burden of sorrow over her lost sister, she maintains a desire to help people. She also harbors a secret delusion that her younger sister is still alive.

# Background
Originally from [[Revolar]], Renna joined the [[Truthkeepers]] after fleeing a forced betrothal to [[Brightlord Juran]]. Following her defection in [[Allegiance at the Abandoned Docks]], she joined the [[Knights of Dusk]]. She treats [[Iiko]] as a surrogate for the sister she could not save.

# Goals
- **Proving Worth:** To make a meaningful difference and prove her value to her parents.
- **Protecting [[Iiko]]:** She has subconsciously adopted [[Iiko]] as a sibling figure and is dedicated to their safety.
- **Escape the Past:** Avoid the reach of [[Brightlord Juran]] and her family's contracts.

# Events
- [[The Boutique Confrontation]]: Faced her former fiancé, [[Brightlord Juran]].
- [[Allegiance at the Abandoned Docks]]: Defected to the [[Knights of Dusk]] to save [[Jory Spadis]].
- [[The Darkstone Siege]]: Actively protected [[Iiko]] from [[Truthkeepers]] snipers during the base's fall.

# Connections
- **[[Iiko]]**: Her protégé and surrogate sibling.
- **[[Chip]]**: A trusted ally.
- **[[Brightlord Juran]]**: Her estranged and vindictive fiancé.
- **[[General Spade]]**: Her commander in the rebellion.

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#lighteyed","#alethi","#truthkeeper"],"last_updated":"2026-05-13T23:35:12","faction":"[[Truthkeepers]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/15 21:01:17","modified":"2026/05/16 23:33:20","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Senny.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A man who is "low tier" for a lighteyes, with a face that is constantly set in a serious, matter-of-fact frown. He is the son of skilled Alethi architects and carries himself with a quiet, unshakeable dignity.

# Appearance
A man who is "low tier" for a lighteyes, with a face that is constantly set in a serious, matter-of-fact frown. He is the son of skilled Alethi architects and carries himself with a quiet, unshakeable dignity.

# Personality
Senny (short for Senninned) is a true believer. He is serious, unyielding, and utterly dedicated to the [[Truthkeepers]]' cause. He doesn't care about his own advancement or prestige; he simply wants to help in any way he can. He is willing to die for the organization and never gives up, no matter the odds.

# Background
Senny originally joined the [[Truthkeepers]] for a simple job at a friend's request. However, after witnessing a fellow believer sacrifice their life to save him from a [[Possessed]] creature, he underwent a spiritual awakening. He now sees the work of the [[Truthkeepers]] as a higher calling that outweighs his family's architectural legacy.

# Goals
- **Service to the Cause:** To fulfill the mission of the [[Truthkeepers]] and honor the sacrifice of the one who saved him.
- **Helping the Camp:** He is focused on the practical needs of the [[Truthkeeper Camp]] and its mission.

# Secrets
His architecture background gives him a unique eye for the "structural" weaknesses in people and organizations, though he rarely uses this for anything other than the camp's benefit.

# Connections
- [[High Witness Yeshan]]: He views Yeshan's mission as a sacred duty.
- [[Ardent Kaelis]]: Senny's mentor in history and ancient architecture.

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A Veden noblewoman and ward to [[Jasnah Kholin]]. In this version of Roshar, she is a sleeper agent for the [[Ghostbloods]] tasked with assassinating her mentor to secure a Soulcaster.

# Personality
Externally shy and witty, Shallan hides a desperate and traumatized core. She is fiercely protective of her family's interests.

# Background
Shallan was recruited by the [[Ghostbloods]] through Luesh, her brother [[Helaran]]'s contact. She truly believes that by stealing Jasnah's working Soulcaster, she can save her family and aid [[Helaran]], unaware that her brother is already dead. She is coming to terms with her role as an assassin and her powers as a Lightweaver.

# Goals
- **Assassinate Jasnah Kholin:** Neutralize her mentor and steal her Soulcaster.
- **Protect Family:** Restore her house's fortune in Jah Keved.

# Connections
- [[Jasnah Kholin]]: Her academic mentor and target.
- [[Helaran]]: Her brother and primary motivation.
- [[Kabsal]]: Unknown to her, a fellow Ghostblood agent in [[Kharbranth]].

NOTE TITLE: [[Sila]]

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#darkeyed","#alethi","#ghostbloods","#mercenary"],"last_updated":"2024-05-27T10:00:00","faction":"[[Ghostbloods]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/19 18:06:06","modified":"2026/05/19 18:06:06","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Sila.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:


# Description
A large, imposing darkeyed man who looks even more dangerous than he is. While he presents as a simple brute, he is a survivor who has been recruited as the second-in-command for [[Koloko]]'s rising Ghostblood cell.

# Appearance
Sila is marked by numerous battle scars, most notably a jagged diagonal gash that crosses his lips. He carries a massive, well-used axe and typically smells of smoke and cheap ale.

# Personality
Sila is craftier than he looks. While he likes drink and can be impulsive with his coin, he has learned to control his emotional outbursts to better serve as a professional enforcer. He provides a tactical, grounded balance to [[Koloko]]'s more elaborate schemes.

# Background
Originally a low-tier darkeyes at the Truthkeeper camp, Sila was liberated by [[Chip]] and [[Karani]] after faking his death. Upon reaching [[Revolar]], he was vetted by [[Koloko]], who recognized that the big man's brutish exterior hid a cunning mind. Sila now serves as the primary muscle and lieutenant for Koloko's operations.

# Goals
- **Survival:** Avoid the notice of the Truthkeepers, who believe him to be dead.
- **Loyalty:** Help [[Koloko]] establish his business, finding steady work more reliable than freelance thuggery.

# Secrets
Sila's "death" by fire was meticulously staged. If any Truthkeepers, particularly [[Adjudicator Peton]], were to recognize him in [[Revolar]], his ruse would be discovered.

# Connections
- [[Koloko]]: His commander and the "mastermind" he supports.
- [[Chip]]: One of his saviors and a current contact within the Ghostbloods.
- [[Karani]]: The other half of the team that freed him from hard labor.

# Description
A mysterious man often seen in a hooded coat. He is a local contact for the [[Ghostbloods]] who confirmed he operates under the authority of [[Chip]] and the [[Undertaker]].

# Personality
Desperate to prove his worth, he often acts as a bridge for initiates. He possesses a dramatic flair and recently provided intelligence that the [[Undertaker]] values "trophies" from distant worlds.

# Background
He is currently based in [[Revolar]], monitoring the influx of [[Nurian Gems]] and investigating the movements of the [[Bloodmarks]] syndicate.

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A Shin man of average height with large, pale eyes. He wears simple white robes and carries an Honorblade. He is a man broken by his status as "Truthless," bound by his culture to obey the commands of whoever holds his oathstone.

# Personality
Szeth suffers from deep, hollow despair. He is a lethal instrument of his master’s will, performing tasks with mechanical efficiency that conflicts with his own desire for morality and his hatred for killing.

# Background
Born in Shinovar, Szeth was named "Truthless" after claiming that the Radiants had returned—a claim the Shin leaders found abhorrent. He was cast out and doomed to carry an Honorblade, serving as a slave to his oathstone. He gained infamy for the assassination of King Gavilar Kholin.

# Goals
- **Obedience:** To follow the commands of his current oathstone master.
- **Atonement:** Though he believes it is impossible, he seeks a death that will end his suffering.
- **Morality:** To avoid unnecessary pain and killing when his master's orders allow.

# Connections
- [[Galeth-son-Thald]]: Galeth remembers Szeth from their homeland, knowing him as a simple shepherd turned soldier.

NOTE TITLE: [[Tahs]]

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#lighteyed","#alethi","#initiate"],"last_updated":"2026-05-13T23:35:12","faction":"[[Truthkeepers]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/15 15:09:41","modified":"2026/05/16 23:33:20","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Tahs.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
A Truthkeeper initiate driven by a desperate need for social validation and rank.

# Appearance
Veden-style reddish hair and striking, dark purple eyes. She is often seen twirling strands of her long hair while watching those around her. She wears the muted robes of a Truthkeeper initiate.

# Personality
Tahs is externally polite but internally consumed by jealousy and a need for social validation. She bullies those she considers beneath her—specifically [[Karani]]—whenever [[Renna Palir]] isn't around. She is deeply concerned with her social appearance and "looking good" to her superiors.

# Background
Adopted by a lighteyed mother who "married down" to a darkeyes, Tahs was never truly loved or accepted by her family. Both of her parents went missing, leaving her with a desperate need for the structure and status offered by the [[Truthkeepers]].

# Goals
- **Social Advancement:** To rise within the ranks of the Truthkeepers and secure the status she feels she was denied by her upbringing.
- **Validation:** To be recognized as superior to her peers, especially those she perceives as "weak."

# Secrets
- Her cruelty toward [[Karani]] is a direct reflection of the unloved childhood she experienced after her parents' disappearance.

# Connections
- **[[Renna Palir]]**: Her friend, whom she secretly envies.
- **[[Karani]]**: Her primary target for bullying.

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#darkeyed","#cartwright","#salimset"],"last_updated":"2024-05-18T00:00:00","faction":null,"location":"[[Salimset]]","created":"2026/05/16 11:35:10","modified":"2026/05/16 23:33:20","chunkId":"03 NPCs/The Axelsmith.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
The Axelsmith, formerly known as "The Axe", is a warrior who found a new purpose in life as a cartwright after his duel with [[Galeth-son-Thald]]. He speaks of himself in the third person.

# Personality
Humble, reflective, and speaks of himself in the third person. He no longer bases his self-worth solely on combat ability.

# Background
Formerly a fearsome warrior known as "The Axe". After losing a brutal duel to [[Galeth-son-Thald]] at Kesh's Gorge, he reflected on his life and realized he should not base all his self-worth on his combat ability. He re-evaluated his priorities and decided to go back to his roots as a simple cartwright, moving to [[Salimset]]. When the party passed by in [[011 Promotions and Revolar]], he fixed the wheel on their chull-pulled wagon free of charge and wished them the best.

# Goals
- Live a simple life as a cartwright in [[Salimset]].
- Apply his skills to repairing and building wagons.
- Avoid conflict and unnecessary violence.

# Connections
- [[Galeth-son-Thald]]: His opponent in a pivotal duel.

NOTE TITLE: [[Tien]]

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#alethi","#soldier","#sadeas_princedom","#stormblessed"],"last_updated":"2024-05-21T09:00:00","faction":"[[Sadeas Princedom]]","location":"[[Tomat]]","created":"2026/05/17 09:59:37","modified":"2026/05/17 21:01:59","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Tien.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
Tien is a young man with a bright, earnest face and curly hair often dusty from the front lines. He is known in the borderlands as the "Stormblessed" for his uncanny ability to survive impossible odds.

# Personality
Tien is naturally artistic and empathetic, often finding beauty in small things. While he once lacked the "killer instinct," his survival of the Jah Keved skirmishes and his brother's sacrifice have forged him into a resilient leader who collects those in need of protection.

# Background
After [[Kaladin]] died saving him in the Jah Keved border skirmishes—a sacrifice that seemingly passed on a unique destiny—Tien threw himself into the military. He is now a competent soldier and squad leader who defies death in [[Tomat]], drawing the attention of both the [[Truthkeepers]] and the [[Ghostbloods]].

# Goals
- **Live Worthily:** To be worthy of [[Kaladin]]'s sacrifice.
- **Protection:** Provide a shield for those under his command, including young recruits like [[Dillind]].

# Hooks
- **The Stormblessed Legend:** His reputation is growing, making him a beacon for potential Radiants and a target for the [[Silent Oath]].
- **Shardbearer Destiny:** He is destined to win a Shardblade in the coming skirmishes near [[Tomat]].

# Connections
- [[Kaladin]]: His fallen brother whose sacrifice defined his new path.
- [[Dillind]]: A young soldier under his protection in [[Tomat]].
- [[Amaram]]: His commanding officer who views him as a prized asset.
- Dallet (Sergeant), Cenn (young recruit), Coreb, Hab, Alabet, Reesh, Acis, Cyn, Hamel, Larn, Lyndel, Navar, Raksha, Toorim, Korater: The soldiers under his command.

METADATA:{"type":"npc","status":"active","tags":["#npc","#thaylen","#ghostbloods","#worldhopper"],"last_updated":"2024-05-28T10:00:00","faction":"[[Ghostbloods]]","location":"[[Revolar]]","created":"2026/05/19 18:36:41","modified":"2026/05/21 10:29:51","chunkId":"03 NPCs/Undertaker.md#0","heading":"Description"}

NOTE BLOCK CONTENT:

# Description
Undertaker is a man of indeterminate age with a weathered, yet sophisticated face. He often wears high-quality, though understated, Alethi silks in dark, somber tones. He carries himself with the quiet confidence of a predator and is rarely seen without a small, exotic avian (a chicken) perched nearby. He often smells faintly of strange perfumes and dried herbs. His eyebrows are dyed black and cut short, hiding his Thaylen origins except to the most discerning eyes.

# Personality
Calculating, patient, and intensely pragmatic. He speaks with a soft, melodic voice with almost no hint of Thaylen accent that carries an underlying threat. He views the world as a grand game of logistics and influence. He is not a zealot; he cares nothing for the Truthkeepers' ideology, but he admires their efficiency in maintaining "order." He is a collector of curiosities and information, valuing anything that grants leverage.

# Background
Operating out of the shadows of [[Revolar]], Undertaker rarely walks the streets without a fresh disguise. Sometimes a weathered soldier, sometimes a merchant, in reality, he is a high-ranking member of the [[Ghostbloods]], overseeing their operations in the region. He reports to Iyatil, who pretends to be his apprentice. He recently brokered a meeting with the squad in the [[Bruckslats]], revealing the dark history behind [[N'tal]]'s family gem mine and [[Fina]]'s accidental involvement.

# Goals
- **Regional Stability:** Keep the peace at all costs so that trade and research into fabrials and worldhopping can continue unhindered.
- **Suppression of the Past:** Actively bury information regarding the Voidbringers or the true history of Roshar.
- **Managing the Radiant Threat:** View the emergence of "Possessed" (Radiants) as a wild card. He supports the [[Truthkeepers]] and [[Silent Oath]] in pruning these elements, unless they can be brought under his specific, covert control.

# Secrets
Undertaker is actually **Mraize**, a worldhopper of significant power and influence. He is not just a merchant; he is a hunter of the highest caliber. He knows far more about the "Possessed" than he lets on and is currently looking for a way to bind Radiants to the Ghostbloods' service as a permanent, controllable asset.

# Connections
- [[Chip]]: His direct field agent around Revolar.
- [[Iyatil]]: His supposed "apprentice" who actually uses him to gather information and manipulate events from the shadows.
- [[N'tal]]: A potential asset whose family tragedy he helped illuminate during the meeting in [[Meeting with the Undertaker]].
- [[Fina]]: A former proxy whose past negligence he has weaponized to test the squad's loyalty.
- [[The Prismatic Palette]]: His new designated meeting spot for squad briefings.

# Description
A desperate merchant in [[Revolar]] who attempted to trade high-value, extra-planetary contraband.

# Appearance
A man with a dejected, weary posture, typical of those struggling to survive in the [[Slipmarket]].

# Personality
Ambitious but fearful. He attempts to sell rare items at exorbitant prices to fund his survival or escape from the city. Not very good with money; buying the pieces for high prices but unable to find appropriate buyers, ending up selling them for far less than they're worth to try to get out of debt to the [[Bloodmarks]].

His one good trait is that he happens to be lucky and talk to interesting people; knack for sensing the weird and obscure.
# Background
The son of wealthy and successful merchants, Zabriel is the opposite. An easy mark, buys high, sells low, squandered all the wealth his family had earned so they disowned him as not being worthy. Trying to become famous so his family will accept him again.

Zabriel was encountered in the [[Slipmarket]] trying to sell a [[Nurian Gems]] specimen that boasted twice the duration and power output of standard gemstones. Shortly after his interaction with the party, he was seen being escorted away by a [[Bloodmarks]] squad, his stall left abandoned.

# Goals
- Sell his remaining stock for maximum profit.
- Evade the notice of the syndicates (failed).
- Become a successful merchant.
- Win back his parents' affection.

# Connections
- [[Bloodmarks]]: The organization that abducted him for dealing in their restricted gems and not paying back his debts.
- [[Undertaker]]: The Ghostblood leader who has a vested interest in the types of "curiosities" Zabriel sells.
